The '''Wasp''' was a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] model produced by [[Minas]] sometime during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Minas Wasp was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the items in the Strategy Alliance Pack on the Cartel Market.

==Appearances==
*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
